candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – Zaposlitev (careers / job ads)
candidates.why_relevant: Bankart is the national card/ATM/POS/SEPA processor for Slovenia and much of the region. Its job ads name concrete systems, payment instruments and projects (e.g. 'poslovni analitik za razvoj IT storitev na podrocju procesiranja sodobnih placilnih instrumentov', Linux system engineer, development engineer analyst) and therefore reveal technology stack and roadmap direction before any formal announcement. Careers pages also carry self-reported volume claims (cards, monthly SEPA and card transactions, ATM/POS estate) usable as corroborating datapoints for card/ATM/POS statistics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /zaposlitev/ plus the individual job-ad permalinks; diff titles and body text over time; snapshot each ad to the Wayback Machine because ads are removed when filled.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language (sl) search on processor name + zaposlitev/kariera
queries_used: Bankart d.o.o. zaposlitev kariera placilni sistemi

candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – LinkedIn company page
candidates.why_relevant: Company posts announce Flik instant-payment milestones, POS/ATM programme news, partnerships and hiring pushes earlier and more informally than press releases; headcount trend and job-function mix on the page are a proxy for where investment is going.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/analyst review of the public post feed; capture permalinks and screenshot; do NOT automate scraping (LinkedIn ToS). Where a post links to bankart.si or a PDF, collect the target instead.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on company name + LinkedIn/objave
queries_used: Bankart novice blog LinkedIn objave placilni sistem flik POS bankomati
candidates.observed_blocker: LinkedIn requires auth for full feed and prohibits automated collection

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Zaposlitev / Kariera (central bank job ads)
candidates.why_relevant: Central-bank vacancy texts reveal which statistical, oversight and payment-infrastructure workstreams are being staffed up (payment statistics reporting, TARGET/instant payments, digital euro, fintech hub), an early indicator of new reporting obligations and forthcoming statistical products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the vacancy listing (incl. the legacy application at apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp) on a weekly cadence; archive each posting.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on zaposlitev + banka Slovenije
queries_used: zaposlitev razvijalec placilni sistemi banka Slovenija prosto delovno mesto

candidates.source_name: Zavod RS za zaposlovanje (ESS) – national public job vacancy register
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national vacancy register: banks, processors and payment institutions publish here even when they do not advertise commercially. Filtering by NACE banking/finance plus payment keywords gives a systematic, low-bias hiring-signal feed and surfaces smaller actors (payment institutions, e-money issuers) missing from a curated actor map.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered periodic search (placilni promet, karticno poslovanje, bankomat, POS, PSD2, SEPA, procesiranje) restricted to finance/banking activity codes; store new ad IDs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search on prosto delovno mesto
queries_used: zaposlitev razvijalec placilni sistemi banka Slovenija prosto delovno mesto

candidates.source_name: Optius.com – Bancnistvo / Finance job category
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator with a dedicated banking/finance category; useful as a cross-check against ESS and as an actor-discovery channel (vendors, integrators and outsourcers hiring for Slovenian bank projects).
candidates.legal_status: commercial site, check robots/ToS before automated crawling
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Category-page polling with keyword filter; respect robots.txt and rate limits.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search snowball from vacancy query
queries_used: zaposlitev razvijalec placilni sistemi banka Slovenija prosto delovno mesto

candidates.source_name: Zaposlitev.net – Slovenian job portal
candidates.why_relevant: Second major commercial aggregator; different employer mix than Optius, so combining the two reduces the chance of missing a bank/processor hiring wave.

candidates.why_relevant: Forward calendar of central-bank conferences, National Payments Council sessions and publication events. Agenda titles disclose upcoming statistical releases and policy themes weeks ahead; pairs with the publication-date calendar for release timing.

candidates.source_name: Delo DPC konference – 'Mobilne tehnologije' conference (mobile payments / digital money)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most payments-specific recurring Slovenian conference agenda found: the 2026 edition (10 June 2026, Grand Plaza Ljubljana) lists speakers from Banka Slovenije (dr. Marko Pahor), NLB (Sandra Milankovic, director of payment and card services) and Bankart (Samo Kumar) on digital money, neobanks and regulation. Session titles and speaker job titles are a direct read on which institution owns which payments programme, ahead of formal announcements.
candidates.legal_status: commercial media site, public agenda pages
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual crawl of the conference URL pattern (…/konference/mobilne-tehnologije<year>/) plus archiving of agenda and speaker pages; extract speaker name + employer + role into the actor map. Also monitor the conference index at dpc.delo.si/konference.

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Vsa izobraževanja / strokovna izobraževanja
candidates.why_relevant: The banking association's training catalogue and professional meetings (notably the recurring 'posvet o placilnih storitvah' for payment-operations staff) reveal which regulatory and operational changes banks are preparing for — instant payments, PSD2/PSD3, fraud rules — typically before implementation. Course descriptions name the standards and deadlines involved.
candidates.legal_status: trade association site, public listing pages
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the training listing and the news/press feed; capture course titles, dates and abstracts.

candidates.why_relevant: Full recordings of the annual ZBS banking conference (2023, 2024 editions found). Spoken remarks and presentation slides frequently contain volume figures, cash-usage commentary and project timelines that never appear in written form — a classic weak-signal and last-resort recovery channel.

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik – e-arhiv (banking journal archive)
candidates.why_relevant: The Slovenian banking journal's electronic archive preserves practitioner articles (and English special issues) that often carry payment-system statistics and market descriptions later removed from institutional websites. Acts as the recovery layer for superseded figures.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted journal; some issues free PDFs, respect licensing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Index issue tables of contents; harvest openly posted PDFs (English special issues are published as open PDFs); cite rather than redistribute paywalled content.

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – 'Arhiv' pages and archived e-newsletters of the National Payments Council
candidates.why_relevant: Superseded/archived central-bank content: the National Payments Council e-newsletter archive (e.g. the November 2019 issue on PIS/AIS services) and generic 'Arhiv' sections retain payment-market descriptions and figures dropped from current pages. This is the on-site equivalent of a web archive and is the highest-value recovery target in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate all /arhiv and /e-novice paths under placila-in-infrastruktura and statistika; mirror PDFs and HTML; cross-check every URL against the Wayback Machine to catch pages already removed.

queries_used: web.archive.org bsi.si placilni instrumenti statistika arhiv stran

candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine – bsi.si / bankart.si / bank domains
candidates.why_relevant: Last-resort recovery channel for statistics tables, tariff/fee schedules, ATM/POS network pages and job ads that are routinely deleted after being superseded. Also permits time-series reconstruction of fee and network-size changes that are never published as a series.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the CDX API (http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=<domain>/*&output=json) to enumerate snapshots per target domain and path, then fetch specific timestamped captures; also proactively submit live statistics pages to Save Page Now so future removals are covered.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles archive-layer reasoning, confirmed by sl archive query
queries_used: web.archive.org bsi.si placilni instrumenti statistika arhiv stran

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian banking/payments industry AWARD programme was identified. Searches in both sl ('nagrada banka leta') and en (fintech/payments award Slovenia winner) returned only international award schemes (Juniper Research Future Digital Awards, Finastra showcase) and generic fintech listicles, plus the BSI Fintech Innovation Hub — none of which is a Slovenian awards programme.
negative_findings.result_summary: Awards sub-channel is effectively empty for SI banking-payments on the evidence gathered; hackathons and conferences carry the signal instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Awards were named in the cell definition as an early-signal channel. If no national award exists, effort should be reallocated to conference agendas and hiring rather than repeatedly re-searching for awards.

negative_findings.description: MojeDelo.com, the job board explicitly named in the query, did not appear in results; only Zaposlitev.net, Optius, BorzaDela and the state ESS register surfaced. MojeDelo may still be live and simply not ranked — this is not evidence it is dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: MojeDelo not confirmed as a usable source in this pass; treat as unverified rather than absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A missing aggregator could mean missed bank vacancies; needs a direct site check next pass.

negative_findings.description: The session's WebSearch budget (200 calls) was exhausted before two planned queries could run: (a) NLB/OTP/Intesa/SKB careers pages and their LinkedIn hiring signals in sl, and (b) the SI/regional fintech event circuit in en (PODIM, Startup Slovenija, regional payments conferences). No fetches of individual pages were performed either.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of issuer-bank careers pages and the English-language regional event circuit is incomplete.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The largest Slovenian issuers (NLB aside from its hackathon, OTP/Nova KBM, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, SKB, Addiko, Sberbank-successor) are the biggest single source of hiring weak signals and are currently under-covered in this slice.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all were observed only as search-engine results. The Bancni vestnik e-archive shows a 'Prijava' (login) layer and LinkedIn is behind a partial login wall — both recorded as hypotheses, not verdicts.
negative_findings.result_summary: All access_status values are inferred from result metadata, not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must treat every entry as unverified.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial-bank careers pages are covered only for Deželna banka and (indirectly) NLB. NLB, OTP banka (ex Nova KBM), Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, SKB (OTP Group), Addiko, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica and Sparkasse careers pages and their LinkedIn hiring feeds were not reached.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one sl query per issuer ('<bank> kariera zaposlitev placilne kartice / placilni promet') and register each careers URL; add LinkedIn company pages as manual-review sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-usage weak signals (CIT companies, cash-in-transit and ATM-estate operators, independent ATM deployers, Bankart's ATM outsourcing partners) were not searched at all. Job ads and tenders from CIT/ATM service firms are the clearest early indicator of ATM estate contraction or expansion.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sl terms: 'prevoz gotovine', 'oskrba bankomatov', 'servis bankomatov zaposlitev', 'vzdrzevanje POS terminalov razpis'.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement / tender portals (e-JN, portal javnih narocil) were not covered in this cell. Bank and public-sector tenders for POS terminals, ATM servicing and payment software are a strong pre-announcement signal, and award notices disclose volumes and values.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ejn.gov.si / Portal javnih narocil keyword monitoring, and coordinate with whichever cell owns procurement so it is not double-covered.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage in this slice is thin — only one en query completed successfully (the awards query) plus the BSI Fintech Hub en page. The en-language regional event circuit (payments conferences in AT/HR/RS with Slovenian speakers) is unexplored.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Next pass, run en queries on 'Slovenia payments conference speakers', 'CEE payments summit Slovenia Bankart NLB speaker', and EPCA/EAST ATM-industry membership pages.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic snapshot inventory was built. The Wayback CDX API was identified as the method but not executed, so it is unknown which SI payment-statistics pages are already well-archived and which are at risk of loss.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a CDX enumeration over bsi.si/statistika*, bsi.si/placila-in-infrastruktura*, bankart.si and each bank domain; proactively Save-Page-Now every live statistics page in the run's target list.

brief: Slovenia's weak-signal layer for banking-payments is small but unusually concentrated: Bankart, as the national card/ATM/POS/SEPA processor, is the single richest node — its own job ads, versioned Flik integration PDFs, LinkedIn feed and third-party-mirrored recruitment decks together disclose stack, roadmap and volume claims well ahead of formal announcements. Event agendas are the second pillar, with Delo DPC's 'Mobilne tehnologije' conference the most payments-specific (2026 edition puts Banka Slovenije, NLB payments/cards and Bankart on one programme), backed by ZBS's training catalogue and recorded banking conference, and DSI's per-year programme subdomains which double as an archive. Hiring signals are best harvested from the statutory ESS vacancy register plus Optius/Zaposlitev.net and the central bank's own vacancy pages; awards, by contrast, appear to be a genuinely empty sub-channel in Slovenia. Recovery of superseded data rests on Banka Slovenije's own /arhiv and National Payments Council e-newsletter paths plus systematic Wayback CDX enumeration, neither of which has yet been inventoried — that, issuer-bank careers pages, and cash-in-transit/ATM-servicing hiring are the main open gaps.
